newsitem.title: USA: Enron Global says Argentine rate disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Enron Global says Argentine rate disappoints.

text.p: Enron Global Power & Pipelines LLC said it was "disappointed" with a tarriff review handed down by the Argentine regulator to its 23.3 percent owned subsidiary Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A.

The resolution from Ente Nacional Regulador del Gas (ENARGAS) included an up-front, one-time tariff reduction of 6.5 percent for the efficiency factor and the framework by which TGS will promote and price future system expansions, Enron said and this did not address investment or other factors which could affect pricing.

"We believe the concepts ENARGAS has applied are inconsistent with the letter and the spirit of the regulatory framework which was intended to encourage operational efficiencies," said Enron Global Power chairman Rodney Gray.
Enron Global Power is a unit of Enron Corp and is to merge with its parent. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
